start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-a-task-plan-as-one-editable-record with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and plans [{\"source_id\": \"contract-builder:plan\", \"title\": \"Build reusable sales contracts\", \"goal\": \"Reuse the shared sales primitives for client contracts\", \"body\": \"Use the existing decision to choose the delivery path.\", \"app\": \"example-ai\"}]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the plans and their progress are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-a-task-plan-as-one-editable-record" with store, and the plans and progress entries to keep.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts: every attempt must be kept, repeated or refused as the intent says, or the run stops and says which.

4. Every later run keeps the new plans and progress through those objects and reads each one back; a refused item comes back with the store's own words for why, and a plan you ask to change is changed only when you say change.

worked_examples.title: A plan kept once, then a progress entry added
worked_examples.ask: Keep my contract plan and note that I drafted the contract.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

plans.title: Build reusable sales contracts
plans.goal: Reuse the shared sales primitives for client contracts
plans.body: Use the existing decision to choose the delivery path.

worked_examples.given: The look step found the plans kept in the table task_plan with its keep function, made by an earlier run.
worked_examples.hands_back: kept_ids ["contract-builder:plan", "step-1"], refused [] and found_ids ["contract-builder:plan", "step-1"]; asking again with the same plan returns it as repeated and unchanged, so a completed plan is never reset by a retry.
